Name: Weather Totems Expanded
Author: TheMightyAmondee
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/hpUZxM9.png[/img][/center]

[size=6][center]Weather Totems Expanded[/center][/size]

[size=3]Weather Totems Expanded adds an additional five totems to change the weather for tomorrow. Now you can also change the weather to be sunny, windy, snowy, stormy or green rainy instead of just rainy. Each totem also has different activation animations.[/size]

[size=3]This will of course have some interesting effects. You can make it snow in summer if you want to! Totems will only activate if they are able to change the weather in that location context. Unfortunately, this does mean most won't work on Ginger Island![/size]

[size=3]A few notes:[/size]
[list]
[*]If a wind totem is used in summer or winter, the forecast will say it will snow. The weather will actually be windy so you can ignore this.
[*]The green rain totem will only work in summer.
[/list]
[b][size=5]The Totems:
[/size][/b]﻿
[b]Sun Totem:[/b] Changes weather to sunny. Recipe unlocked at Foraging level 8.
[left]﻿[/left][left][/left][left][b]Wind Totem:[/b] Changes weather to windy (debris weather). Recipe unlocked at Foraging level 4. Won't work on Ginger Island.
﻿[/left][b]Snow Totem: [/b]Changes weather to snowy. Recipe unlocked at Foraging level 8. Won't work on Ginger Island.

[b]Thunder Totem:[/b] Changes weather to stormy. Recipe unlocked at Foraging level 9. Won't work on Ginger Island.

[b]Green Rain Totem:[/b] Changes weather to green rain. Recipe unlocked at Foraging level 9. Won't work on Ginger Island.

[b][size=5]Install
[/size][/b]
The mod consists of two parts. A C# part to add functionality and a CP part to add the items. The CP part can be used without the C# part for non-functional totem items, however, the C# part requires the CP part.

This mod requires SMAPI 4.0 or later and Content Patcher 2.0 or later.

[b]To install:[/b]

1. Download the mod here!
2. Extract (unzip) the contents of the downloaded .zip file into your "Mods" folder
3. Enjoy!
4. To uninstall - simply remove the mod from the "Mods" folder. All totems will turn into error items which can be safely trashed.

[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
Should be fully compatible with multiplayer. Let me know if you encounter any issues.
No known incompatibilities.
Stardew Valley Expanded has its own Sun and Wind Totems. Don't worry, they won't confict with Weather Totems Expanded and function identically to the ones added by this mod. Either may be used to change the weather.

Full translation support is included for both parts of the mod. New translations always welcome! Just send me the files when you're done (full credit to you, obviously). Translations are released under optional files unless otherwise specified.
